verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional skill, or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-geographic-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who include specific geographic or logistical details, such as village names or transport costs, may fund more slowly.

female-age-faster.body: Female borrowers over the age of 50 may fund faster than younger female borrowers.

female-repayment-confidence-faster.body: Female borrowers who express confidence or determination regarding loan repayment may fund faster.

female-health-boilerplate-puzzle.body: The use of standardized boilerplate phrasing regarding health and hazard risks may influence funding speed for female borrowers.

female-verbosity-faster-puzzle.body: For female borrowers, increased pitch length may correlate with faster funding, contradicting the general trend.

male-repayment-promises-slower.body: Male borrowers who make explicit promises of timely repayment may fund more slowly.

male-education-faster-puzzle.body: Male borrowers who mention education or learning conditions for themselves or their children may fund faster.

female-environmental-protection-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention environmental protection in their pitches may fund faster.

female-virtue-descriptors-slower.body: The use of self-descriptors like 'hardworking entrepreneur' may predict slower funding for women.

female-survival-needs-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention using the loan for basic survival needs, such as food, may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-promises-slower.title: Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude markers or promises to repay may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-promises-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that faster pitches include explicit expressions of gratitude.

numerical-quantities-slower-general.title: Pitches that include precise currency amounts or specific numerical quantities tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
numerical-quantities-slower-general.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that longevity numbers accelerate funding; retired to maintain claim cap.

business-longevity-faster-general.title: Emphasizing a long duration of business experience or longevity predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-longevity-faster-general.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-partner-status-faster.

female-partner-status-faster.title: Pitches from women that include details about the employment or social status of a spouse or partner are associated with increased funding speed.
female-partner-status-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-virtue-descriptors-faster-claim.

female-virtue-descriptors-faster-claim.title: Pitches from women that describe the borrower using terms like 'hardworking' or 'entrepreneur' are associated with increased funding speed.
female-virtue-descriptors-faster-claim.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-business-longevity-faster.

female-business-longevity-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize a longer duration of business ownership fund faster.
female-business-longevity-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promotion of female-personal-status-slower.

female-institutional-training-slower.title: Female borrowers who emphasize institutional training or certifications may fund more slowly.
female-institutional-training-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle that lacked corroboration over 110 batches.

female-institution-name-slower.title: Mentioning the specific name of the lending institution may predict slower funding for women.
female-institution-name-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle that lacked corroboration over 102 batches.

male-aspirational-slower.title: Broad aspirational language regarding social service may predict slower funding for men, suggesting a gender interaction.
male-aspirational-slower.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle that lacked corroboration over 66 batches.

female-personal-status-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention marital status, number of children, or personal hardships fund more slowly.
female-personal-status-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that marital and family status may actually accelerate funding.
